name: Al Waahid
description: Allah is One, without partner or equal.
summary: Al Waahid reflects the concept of divine unity in Islam, underscoring the belief that Allah is singular and incomparable. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'W-H-D', which conveys the idea of oneness and individuality. It is a reminder of Allah's sole sovereignty and His singular nature, reinforcing the central tenet of Tawhid in Islamic belief.
